events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect existing T-053 files, referral partners and team roster
events.input: $ ls -la workshop-plan/outputs/t053/ workshop-plan/outputs/t053-linkedin-posts.html && wc -l workshop-plan/outputs/t053/*.py && cat workshop-plan/ops/referrals.json | head -60 && python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the build script, the posts source header and the publish log tail
events.input: $ cat workshop-plan/outputs/t053/build.py | cut -c1-400 && sed -n 1,25p workshop-plan/outputs/t053/posts_src.py | cut -c1-600 && grep -c "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md; tail -5 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read build checks, list referral members, check publish hold and find the mirror publish script
events.input: $ sed -n 40,51p workshop-plan/outputs/t053/build.py | cut -c1-300; sed -n 84,91p workshop-plan/outputs/t053/build.py | cut -c1-300; python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Include every member in the build, rebuild with checks, and locate the mirror publish tooling
events.input: $ sed -i '' 's/^ms = \[m for m in referrals.members(cfg) if m\["kind"\] == "team" or m\["code"\] == "bhaskardev"\]$/ms = referrals.members(cfg)  # every member in meta.team plus both partners in referrals.json (bhaskardev, vaibhavi)/' workshop-plan/outputs/t053/build.py && sed -n 8p workshop-plan/outputs/t053/build.py && python3 workshop-plan/outputs/t053/build.py; echo exit $?; git status --short workshop-plan/outputs | head; grep -rln "tantra-workshop-live" workshop-plan/ops workshop-plan/tasks scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.json\|\.md\|\.html\|dryrun" | head -8; grep -n "publish held" /Us
